Which statement about the atomic structure of the named element is correct?
A
Antimony, Sb, has only four occupied electron shells.
B
Selenium, Se, has only six electrons in its third electron shell.
C
Strontium, Sr, has four outer-shell electrons.
D
Xenon, Xe, has five fully occupied electron shells.
